lessons.title: Positioning: why the smaller market is the bigger lever
lessons.hook: A product for everyone is noticed by no one. What positioning really is, why narrow wins first, and the research that speaks against it.

lessons.title: Preparing for an AI-shaped decade: what you can actually do
lessons.hook: Nobody can forecast how this goes. You do not need to. Six moves for work, skills, money and security that pay off in every future.

lessons.title: Solid-state batteries: why they are so hard to build
lessons.hook: Twice the range, always five years away. The battery already exists in buses. Four hard problems keep it out of your car.

lessons.title: Not a lack of attention: what the ADHD brain regulates differently
lessons.hook: Hyperfocus for six hours, but no start on the tax form. The name is misleading: attention is there, the steering is not.

lessons.title: AI doom: what experts actually worry about
lessons.hook: Not evil robots. A very capable system with a slightly wrong goal. Who is worried, what speaks against it, and how to think about it calmly.

lessons.title: What a neural network actually computes
lessons.hook: No database, no rules: just weigh, add, bend. And why the kink, of all things, makes everything possible.
